title: Reputation-Based Byzantine-Resilient Vector Consensus without Prespecified Fault Bounds
summary: This paper proposes an adaptive reputation-based algorithm for Byzantine-resilient vector consensus in distributed multi-agent systems. The proposed algorithm does not require a prespecified bound on the number of Byzantine neighbors as an algorithmic input. Instead, each agent evaluates neighboring behavior from observed state discrepancies and updates reputation weights using accumulated behavioral evidence.
